speaker: AXIOM-7
text: AXIOM-7: VTOL flight systems online. Avionics decoupled from Citadel air traffic control. Dual ion-thrusters at 100% output.

speaker: MIRAGE
text: MIRAGE: Look at those flight decks shrink behind us. The fleet is grounded, their interceptors crippled in their berths. The sky is ours.

speaker: TITAN
text: TITAN: Feels good to fly something built like a fortress. Hydraulic clamps didn't stand a chance. This bird can take a pounding.

speaker: OCEANUS
text: OCEANUS: Look through the storm squall below. The city lights are shining without the sky-shield dome. Three municipal sectors breathing free tonight.

speaker: AURA
text: AURA: I can hear the Citadel's distress broadcast. High command is in full panic. They're scrambling all exterior hull automated defense batteries.

speaker: SURYA
text: SURYA: Sensor lock dead ahead! We've broken through the storm ceiling... Look at the Spire. Kilometers of armored exterior plating.

speaker: AXIOM-7
text: AXIOM-7: Telemetry warning: Outer Spire heavy anti-air batteries detecting our radar signature. Direct flight to the summit is blocked by automated hull turrets.

speaker: MIRAGE
text: MIRAGE: Then we don't land at the top. We insert directly onto the exterior maintenance catwalks. We scale the Spire outer hull on foot!

speaker: KAITO
text: KAITO: Agreed. Secure your harnesses. We breach the Spire's outer skin and carve our way to the summit. Operatives—prepare for exterior insertion!
